_comment: Each step of the Defender XDR kit, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls it supports and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators aligned to them. The pairs are the Defender XDR implementation guide's 'Requirements and KSIs' table (Gates 1 to 10), which carries them from the Security Operations book (Chapter 12) and the Devices book (Chapter 10), checked there against fedramp.gov; AU-9 to KSI-MLA-OSM is the privileged access guide's. The runbook's steps (PRE, RUN, PUBLISH, RB) reuse pairs from those rows. Control parts are short paraphrases, not NIST's text. KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with them and doesn't report KSIs itself. Which step supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides. 'stages' lists the steps each stage's evidence must hold before the go/no-go.

AC-2.title: Account Management
AC-2.part: monitor the use of accounts (12: account monitoring for atypical usage)

AC-6.title: Least Privilege
AC-6.part: allow only the access users need to accomplish assigned tasks

AU-6.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
AU-6.part: review and analyze audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity; (1) automated process integration; (3) correlate audit record repositories

AU-9.title: Protection of Audit Information
AU-9.part: protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification and deletion

AU-11.title: Audit Record Retention
AU-11.part: retain audit records for the time period the retention policy sets

CA-7.title: Continuous Monitoring
CA-7.part: ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness, correlation and analysis, and response

CM-3.title: Configuration Change Control
CM-3.part: review, approve, document and monitor configuration-controlled changes

CM-6.title: Configuration Settings
CM-6.part: establish, implement and monitor configuration settings

CM-7.title: Least Functionality
CM-7.part: prohibit or restrict functions, ports, protocols, software and services not needed

CM-8.title: System Component Inventory
CM-8.part: develop and maintain an accurate inventory of system components

IR-4.title: Incident Handling
IR-4.part: handle incidents: preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication and recovery; (1) automated incident handling processes

IR-6.title: Incident Reporting
IR-6.part: report incidents to the designated authorities in the required time

RA-5.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
RA-5.part: monitor and scan for vulnerabilities, analyze the reports and remediate

SC-7.title: Boundary Protection
SC-7.part: monitor and control communications at external and key internal interfaces (the host firewall)

SI-2.title: Flaw Remediation
SI-2.part: identify, report and correct system flaws

SI-3.title: Malicious Code Protection
SI-3.part: implement malicious code protection at entry and exit points

SI-4.title: System Monitoring
SI-4.part: monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks; (7) automated response to suspicious events

SI-7.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
SI-7.part: detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware and information (tamper protection)

ACCESS.title: G1 Service architecture and access: roles and the Graph read path

COVERAGE.title: G2 Endpoint onboarding: coverage and sensor health against the inventory

PREVENTION.title: G3 Endpoint prevention: device state against the ring's stage

ASR.title: G4 Attack Surface Reduction: rule-by-ring matrix, readiness, device check

EXPOSURE.title: G5 Exposure management: owned remediation, Exposure Management disposition

INCIDENTS.title: G6 XDR incidents: severity table, owners, classification

DETECTIONS.title: G7 Detections as code: validation, tests and the deployment plan

SIGNALS.title: G8 Identity and cloud-app signals: the cross-source query

AUTOMATION.title: G9 Automation: device group levels against the ladder, exclusions

METRICS.title: G10 Operations and evidence: the metrics

PUBLISH.title: Runbook: detection rules published from the repository
